How is Unterkiel-Sicherheitsabstand-Vermessung used in maritime?

Definition

Hydrographic assessment confirming minimum clearance between keel and seabed along planned passage meets safety criteria.

Operational example

Hydrographic Office: Underkeel margin survey completed; minimum clearance on route is one point two metres above required UKC.
